requirements_summary: Verdant is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for a payments fraud-detection and customer support stack. Key non-negotiables: VPC deployment into their AWS account, customer-managed KMS keys for model and audit log encryption, SIEM-compatible audit exports (Splunk + Datadog primarily), 7-year retention capability with immutable archive option, and a clear log schema that avoids storing raw PII. Low tolerance for unpredictable routing; prefer guaranteed region residency (us-east-1) and per-request audit trail accessible via their SIEM.
notes:
Summary notes and call fragments:
- 'We cannot have logs leave our account' — security lead on 2026-02-10 call.
- Primary ask: SIEM export to Splunk (HEC) and Datadog (HTTP JSON). Sumo/CEF optional.
- Retention: default 90d fine for telemetry; compliance requires 7y cold archive for audit logs. Legal wants WORM/immutable option.
- Log schema: want one-line JSON events, schema fields below. Must include request_id, model, model_version, timestamp, tenant_id, user_id_hash, prompt_hash, token_count, response_token_count, latency_ms, node_id, batch_id, kv_cache_hit(boolean), decision (served/fallback), error_code/null, redaction_flags.
- PII policy: customer will send prompt samples for review; Redwood must provide redaction pipeline or clear instructions for client-side hashing/redaction before sending.
- KMS: customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) required for both storage at rest and for encrypting audit logs before they leave VPC. Need proof-of-concept showing CMK usage and key rotation impact on decryption of archived logs.
- SIEM forwarding: prefer HTTPS push to private endpoint (customer-managed collector) over pulling logs. Also acceptable: syslog/CEF via TLS to their collectors.
- Monitoring: token-level cost breakdown desirable in logs (token_count + model_version) to map costs to internal teams.
- Action items: provide detailed SIEM export spec, retention SLA options, KMS POC steps, sample log payloads, and updated security pack (attestation + controls mapping).
- Quote: 'If Redwood can show immutable logging + CMK, we can push to procurement Q2' (head of infra).
preferred_siem_endpoints: Splunk-HEC (https://splunk.example.com/services/collector), Datadog-HTTP (https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com/v1/input), or syslog/CEF over TLS to customer collector
po_caveats: Must include SLA language for retention and immutable archive; KMS proof and runbook for key rotation required prior to PO. Pricing needs separate line for long-term archived log storage and SIEM egress bandwidth.
sales_pitch_notes: Emphasize private control plane, per-request auditability, CMK support, and pre-built SIEM forwarders. Highlight Redwood Optimize for reducing token volume in support flows to control ARR. Offer 90-day pilot with staging VPC + SIEM connector for technical validation.
